title: Underwhelming First Collector's Box
text: This was our first collector box. Two stars for the Funko Pop.  The rest of the box was disappointing and underwhelming.  The taco truck looks like a cheap kid's meal toy.  The shipment box was bashed, and the Funko Pop box cellophane has wear on the front from sliding around in the box. It would be nice if this collector's box was packaged inside an outer box to avoid damage.  Don't feel this was worth the $30, but I'm waiting to see what is in the next subscription before I decide on canceling.
label: negative
